notes:
v0.6.48: Two bug fixes caught during live-box testing
of the v0.6.46 backup/restore feature.

1. _new_token() used `xxd` which isn't on the box.
   ReticulumHF base doesn't ship xxd (only od / hexdump
   on the basic coreutils). v0.6.46 restore previews
   silently fell back to a 12-char time-based token,
   which is fine for the URL but it's brittle. Fixed
   in v0.6.48: use Python's `secrets.token_hex(16)` for
   a proper 32-char hex token with no shell dependency.

2. shutil.copy2 fails with PermissionError when the
   target file is owned by root (e.g. /home/pi/.config/pat/
   config.json is root:root because the pat .deb creates
   it that way, and the bootstrap's `sudo install -o pi
   -g pi` doesn't override it). The launcher runs as
   pi, so the unshilded copy fails. v0.6.46 apply
   returned 500 with [Errno 13] Permission denied on
   this exact file. Fixed in v0.6.48: on PermissionError,
   retry with `sudo -n install -D -o pi -g pi -m 0644
   <src> <dst>`. The launcher's user is in sudoers
   (nopasswd) on every deployed g90, so the retry
   succeeds. Non-perm OSErrors (ENOSPC etc.) still
   bubble up.

Discovered 2026-09-09 21:50 MDT during a live-box
restore test on a freshly-bootstrapped reticulumpi
box. First preview correctly identified 1 add / 5
skip; apply returned 500 with the PermissionError;
after the fix, apply succeeds and the operator-notes
file lands on the live box.
